title: blumea spinidens
intro: Blumea spinidens, commonly known as the Prickly Leaf Blumea, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Blumea spinidens include sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative activities. The plant's therapeutic actions may also include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit potential antitumor and antiviral effects.
